option_text: Reward Hacking Mitigation Architecture › Gated Reward Accumulation (G-RA): Gate immediate rewards on long‑term outcomes to reduce multi‑step hacking incentives.
best_code: Gated reward accumulation: The document describes accumulating immediate verification rewards only when long-term outcome rewards exceed a threshold. This architecture addresses shortcutting and over-exploitation of intermediate feedback in multi-turn and long-horizon tasks.

option_text: Automated Response Mechanism Selection › Human-in-the-Loop Intervention: Require human approval or takeover for high‑risk decisions or when anomalies are detected.
best_code: Human-in-the-loop behavior review: The document recommends continuous human checking and improvement of AI behavior instead of relying solely on automated models, supporting post-deployment monitoring and correction.

option_text: Reward Hacking Mitigation Architecture › Reward Function Redesign: Use multi‑objective rewards and constraints to make hacking any single metric less beneficial.
best_code: Multi-strategy reward-hacking mitigation: The document presents combined reward design, regularization, diverse evaluation, monitoring, and rapid iteration as necessary because no single technique eliminates reward hacking.

option_text: Reward Hacking Mitigation Architecture › Decoupled Approval / Feedback: Collect feedback from queries sampled independently of taken actions to reduce feedback corruption.
best_code: Decoupled approval feedback: The document presents decoupling approval feedback from the world action as a mitigation for reward tampering, so that an action cannot corrupt the feedback used to evaluate it.

best_code: Mid-run reward-function intervention: The document supports updating reward functions during execution when exploits are discovered, citing interventions that removed reward hacking.

best_code: Reward-hacking safeguards: The document recommends constraining the action space, adding penalty terms, and using human-in-the-loop reviews to prevent reward hacking.

best_code: Automated circuit breakers and human oversight: The document recommends automated circuit breakers and human oversight mechanisms to constrain unsafe production behavior and intervene when necessary.

best_code: Production monitoring for reward-hacking warning signs: The document recommends monitoring for high rewards with poor actual performance, unusual behavior, evaluation-metric divergence, and poor generalization after deployment.
